data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'stara' meaning to protect, hide or cover. The name Mastura signifies one who is protected, guarded or sheltered by Allah. The name Mastura carries the meaning “Protected, Guarded” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mastura usually hope their child will grow to embody protected, guarded and live with faith, good character and purpose.
